This book will certainly deepen your faith journey whether you have experience in reading the Bible or are new to it.

Not sound doctrine. I loved the idea of this app, but its filled with messages that are misguided and not aligned with context. Six months in and I am ready to start over somewhere else. 

1) Narrator makes frequent claims to his own ministry (Alpha) claiming how awesome it is and all of the work it does- this should be off putting with any ministry. He also frequently references Joyce Meyer, Rick Warren, etc who are known heretics (see “Charismatic church”) in similar fashion to the Hillsong stuff. And its not once or twice. Its at LEAST once per week if not more.

2) The narrator seems to have very loose doctrine often glossing over entire lessons in the Bible after it was just read. Instead of breaking down the context and interpreting what sinners often do not want to hear, he will divert to “love, love, love” instead of speaking the true message. The narrator’s messages have obvious liberal undertones.

3) the app does automatically go back to the place you left off if you miss a day or two. The app will continue on as if you did those days. Folks not paying attention could end up missing entire sections of the Bible. The app should instead only put check marks on the actual progress instead of going off the phone’s calendar. 

If you do decide to still use this app, have a reference text out as well as a comparison such as the Blue Letter Bible to conduct your own study.

Life changing. Despite being a Cristian for most of my life, I never had much interest in reading the entire Bible. But when my friend Roger told me he had just finished doing it, my indifference was transformed to curiosity. Later, a friend who does not identify as Christian sent me a letter quoting scripture to support her position on a social issue, and I thought “You can’t just pick and choose which verses to believe.” I was further convinced of the need. So I set about to read the whole thing, and this app not only made it doable, but it encouraged me and gave me insights along the way. Just having a convenient way to track my progress was a big help. But I also loved how the readings were organized and Nicky’s commentary to pull it together and addd perspective. Finally, I loved Pippa’s “Adds” which brought some levity and humanity to the series. I highly recommend this app! I got so much insight from reading the WHOLE Bible, God thinks big-picture - From Abraham and the formation of the nation of Israel to the gospel coming to the gentiles, you get a sense for the sweep of history and the miraculous prophetic connections between books written hundreds of years apart. You also see how God continually redeems our sin and disobedience. We need God more than we think - I walked away with deeper understanding of the expansiveness of God’s love and our need of Grace. Despite our best efforts, we are all prone to fall away from him and follow our own sinful paths. It seems like God’s people get it right about 20% of the time, at best. The rest of the time we are turning away. God’s character is more complex than we think - Scripture tells us, “God is love.” But what does love look like? In the Bible we see his creativity, humor, humility, compassion, jealousy and anger. We read of God’s judgement, his justice and his vengeance. Revelation is not light reading. Yet, I was not left with fear, but with awe at the sacrificial love of Christ that makes a way for all who would believe. God is more powerful than we can imagine - From creation to second coming of Christ, from the stopping of the sun to the shutting of the lion’s mouths in the lion den, we see how God defies the laws of nature and causes kingdoms to rise and fall. He makes a way where there is no way. There is peace in knowing God is in control - even if he doesn’t alway do what you want him to do. The Bible is a mysterious treasure worth pursuing - I have to confess that there’s still a lot about the Bible I don’t get. It keeps me humble to realize that I only know in part, understand in part. And my understanding does not validate or invalidate the Bible. Yet, the more I dig into it, the more I find to discover. The Bible says that God rewards those who earnestly seek him, and I’m rediscovering how reading the Bible is one important way I can do that. If you’ve ever wondered what’s in the whole Bible, maybe this is the year to read it and find out for yourself.

reviews.text: With the audio it's great!. I love this app! I had previously tried simply reading the Bible in a year but often was too rushed to really tie things together and draw upon the parallels. This app does a great job! Now that they have audio recordings of the devotional portions of it, I can listen to it in my car on the way to work. I love it! Thanks and keep up the great work!
Mama natural. Great discovery thanks to you tuber mama natural. Thanks!!

Love it!. I love this app! I love the audio and follow along. If you want to read the bible and do take the time, fit this in your daily routine. Like it was said, we have to fit into God's plan and NOT fit God into our plan. Jesus is the savior and we have to repent and hold Him close to our hearts and lives. I highly recommend this app. I have 'learned' so much and there is more to come. Thank you.

Makes hard reading more enjoyable. I look forward to my reading, thanks to his enjoyable commentaries. 
I love his commentary, it's interesting and gives good summaries about the readings. The commentary makes absorbing the material easier.
Now, into the 3rd month of the year, I can say I've never missed a day--something I've never been able to do with a one year plan before. 
I like to read the Old Testament part in the Message version, which also makes it easier.
Great resource. Great way to read and study the Bible.
Notifications. Great so far. Just wish there could be an option for push notifications or either text messages to remind you. I have only used it for one day but I already like it.

Good app some drawbacks. I, in general like this app. It is simple and easy to follow. The only drawback that I have is that it is only available in the NIV, which I am no longer fond of. It would be nice to have other versions offered.

Great. Just want to add a review since this app deserves it. If you a Sirius about reading the Bible, GET THIS APP. I'm 15 and I have already read the Bible around 3 times with this Greatly made app. I'm glad people have the Faith to make such an app.

Perfect Bible App. I am so grateful to have found this app. Not only does it have wonderful devotionals for each day, but it has the Bible passages built in as well. This is a wonderful tool for digging deeper into God's Word.

Get this app. I recommend getting this app. The format for reading the bible and the commentaries are excellent. They provide a good explanation for some passages that I don't quite understand. I have completed two years of BIOY and haven't found s better app yet.
Love the app!!. This is a great app! I've been wanting to read through the Bible and this is perfect! Thank you for the time and thought you've put into this.
Awesome!. I love the stories that go along with the daily verses.
Best App Ever. I think it's a good app!

Holy Spirit Inspired !!!. Wow what a great app! Love the way different passages are tied together for each day's topic!
Thank you!!!
Perfect. This is just what I have been searching for, Clear, simple and thoughtful daily explanation of the Lord's word. God Bless You!

The best devotional app!. This app is so perfectly simple and works so well. And of course the commentaries are great thoughts to help to learn from scripture. The only thing it is missing is a way to journal/bookmark and write down things I want to remember from what I have read.
Must have Bible app. Just wonderful and enlightening. Highly recommended.

Wonderful way to keep on track. I have used this app for 2 years and it has helped me so much! The author opens with real life experiences, a psalm or proverb, then New and Old Testament verses. The Bible is so relevant for today and the content of this app makes this very clear. Great for those reading each year or for the new Christian who is not familiar with the Bible at all. I also like that you can read the commentary and then click onto the actual text. A must have!

Beautiful format, thoughtful commentary. This will be my 25th year of going through the Bible. To keep it interesting, I have used various plans. A few years ago I found this one. As I am on my devices more than I care to admit, it is perfect. The format is good and readable. Overall, I would highly recommend.
Perfect Bible in a year app. Love to start my day out with this app! Thank you!

Love this app worth having. I love this app this is my second year with it and it has helped me out so much. Just the way they give you real world examples put the bible in an easy way for you to understand. I was wondering if they can do a version for children I would love to share this experience with my children and have the bible put into a way that they can understand so that the bible is easy for them as well. Get This!. Definitely one of the most organized and detailed apps I have!
